mechanism_narrative: The four-week monotone climb in PARKS from -20.9 to +19.3 percent shows discretionary outdoor activity is being restored; because park excursions share trip chains with adjacent retail-and-recreation venues, continued PARKS strength lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS holds at or above +15 for three more weeks while the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC stays at or below the prior 28-day mean of -55.5.

mechanism_narrative: Transit-station volume is the enabling channel for non-local shopping trips. Once TRANSIT crosses above -40 percent of baseline, cross-district retail trips become materially cheaper than staying local, so RETAIL_REC accelerates within two weeks of the crossing.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -40.0 percent of baseline
failure_condition: TRANSIT prints above -40.0 for two consecutive weeks but the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC does not exceed the prior 28-day mean of -55.5.

mechanism_narrative: Commuting restoration and transit availability interact multiplicatively: WORKPLACES recovery alone generates after-work retail only when TRANSIT is open enough to permit discretionary detours. The joint condition, not either series alone, drives RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves past -35.0 while TRANSIT remains above -50.0 in the same week
failure_condition: The joint condition holds for two consecutive weeks yet the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC fails to exceed the prior 28-day mean of -55.5.

mechanism_narrative: Under a post-emergency reopening regime with no reinstated stay-at-home instruction, the fall in RESIDENTIAL from +24.6 to +14.9 means households are reallocating time out of the home; that reallocation mechanically adds visits to retail-and-recreation venues over the next two weeks.
regime_hint: post-emergency reopening with no reinstated stay-at-home order
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below +12.0 while the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC does not exceed the prior 28-day mean of -55.5.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS runs above +25 while RESIDENTIAL is still above +12, visible crowding in a still partly dormant city raises the political cost of keeping venues open; prefectural authorities then re-tighten guidance, pushing RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean exceeds +25.0 with RESIDENTIAL still above +12.0
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS turned positive at +19.3 while RETAIL_REC is still -37.6
failure_condition: PARKS exceeds +25.0 for two consecutive weeks with no new restriction announcement and the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC stays above -55.5.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen 35.4 points in three weeks while TRANSIT rose only 16.8 and WORKPLACES 19.0, so the retail rebound is carried by one-off reopening visits rather than a restored commute routine; this divergence makes the level fragile and it mean-reverts lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC minus TRANSIT exceeds 8.0 points for two further consecutive weeks
failure_condition: The RETAIL_REC-minus-TRANSIT gap exceeds 8.0 points for two further weeks while the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC still exceeds the prior 28-day mean of -55.5.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal tsuyu rainfall shifts discretionary trips from open-air parks into covered retail corridors. A PARKS pullback of at least five points from +19.3 within one week signals rain-shifted activity that is redirected to covered retail-and-recreation venues, raising the 28-day RETAIL_REC mean.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean drops at least 5.0 points from +19.3
failure_condition: PARKS drops at least 5.0 points from +19.3 and the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC does not exceed the prior 28-day mean of -55.5.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has converged from -26.4 to -10.0, showing pantry stockpiling is finished; the released grocery budget share rotates into deferred discretionary categories, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM stays within 3.0 points of -10.0 for two more weeks while the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC does not exceed the prior 28-day mean of -55.5.
